producte1.descripcio: A Dark Presence stalks the small town of Bright Falls, pushing Alan Wake to the brink of sanity in his fight to unravel the mystery and save his love.

producte2.descripcio: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus epidemic. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and face hordes of the infected.

producte3.descripcio: While searching for answers about his past, Wolverine will do whatever it takes: unleashing brutal clawing, violent rage, and an unrelenting determination to unravel the mystery of the man he used to be.

producte4.descripcio: In Crimson Desert, an open-world action-adventure awaits, set on the continent of Pywel, a place where beauty and cruelty go hand in hand. You will step into the shoes of Kliff of the Graymanes and embark on a journey to reclaim everything you have lost in these lands. Explore uncharted territories, confront new gangs, and immerse yourself in a world as beautiful as it is ruthless. After the Black Bear attack, Kliff has lost his fellow Graymanes, who were like family to him. Amidst the threats and conflicts that plague the continent of Pywel, begin a journey to reunite the scattered beings in each of the stories, restore the honor of the Graymanes, and reclaim their lost home.

producte5.descripcio: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

producte6.descripcio: Yandere Simulator is an action-stealth video game developed by YandereDev for Windows. The story follows the obsessively in love student Ayano Aishi, nicknamed "Yandere-chan", who takes the initiative to eliminate anyone she believes attracts the attention of her "senpai", Taro Yamada.

producte7.nom: The Last of Us™ Part II Remastered
producte7.descripcio: Cinco años después de su peligroso viaje por unos Estados Unidos pospandémicos, Ellie y Joel se han asentado en Jackson, Wyoming. La vida en una próspera comunidad de supervivientes les ha permitido disfrutar de paz y estabilidad, a pesar de la amenaza constante de los infectados y de otros supervivientes más desesperados. Sin embargo, tras un hecho violento que altera esa paz, Ellie se embarca en un viaje implacable en busca de justicia.

producte8.descripcio: Lead the Phantom Thieves of Hearts in this award winning, stylish turn-based RPG filled with dungeon crawling, party customization, strategic combat, and Persona fusion. Explore Tokyo, build relationships, battle Shadows, and infiltrate the minds of the corrupt to make them change their ways!
